assistant.title: QR Safety Assistant
assistant.welcome: Hello! I am your QRaksha safety guide. Ask me any question regarding QR payment safety, fraud prevention, or how this application works.
assistant.q1: How does QR fraud detection work?
assistant.a1: QRaksha inspects the technical parameters inside the QR code (such as VPA format, payee name, currency code, and embedded links). It looks for tampered parameters, unexpected web redirects, and missing merchant details.
assistant.a2: Green means our heuristic checks did not detect any suspicious indicators in the QR data. However, you should still always confirm that the displayed merchant name matches the shopkeeper you are paying.
assistant.q3: Why is a QR code marked Red?
assistant.a3: A QR code is marked Red if it contains malicious URLs, invalid characters, malformed payment amounts, or attempts to execute non-standard actions instead of a genuine UPI payment.
assistant.q4: Can a QR code steal money from my account?
assistant.a4: A QR code itself cannot automatically deduct money without your PIN. However, fraudsters trick victims into scanning QR codes by falsely claiming 'scan this to receive money'. Remember: You NEVER scan a QR code to receive money!
assistant.q5: Is the money in QRaksha real?
assistant.a5: No. QRaksha is strictly an educational tool. All wallet balances and transactions are completely simulated demonstration data.
